# Code map

<!-- Generated by `npm run codemap` from the source. Do not edit by hand except the task table in scripts/codemap.mjs. -->

**How to use it (saves tokens):** find the function here, then read only those lines
(e.g. `Read src/main.js offset 640 limit 60`, or `grep -n "function bossAI" src/main.js`). Don't read `main.js` whole.
Line numbers are `name:line`. `npm test` fails if this file is stale; run `npm run codemap` after editing code.

## Where to change what

| Task | Start here |
|---|---|
| Add or rebalance a perk / combo / Masterwork | `src/upgrades.js` `UPGRADES` (+ `GAIN` line if a new stat) · test in `test/game-logic.test.js` |
| Tune story difficulty or rewards | `src/story.js` `difficulty()`, `roomReward()` · the "harder every room / wing" tests must pass |
| Add or change a story wing | `src/story.js` `WINGS` (enemy mix, density, floor, rug) |
| Add or reprice a Renovation | `src/meta.js` `RENOVATIONS` (+ `runBonuses()` if it is not a stat) |
| Endless wave pacing | `src/waves.js` `ENEMY_TYPES`, `waveBudget()`, `composeWave()` |
| New enemy type | `src/waves.js` `ENEMY_TYPES` → `main.js` `DEF`, `updateEnemies()` switch, `drawEnemy()`, `killEnemy()` colours |
| Boss behaviour | `main.js` `bossAI()` (tiers come from `difficulty().bossTier`) |
| Player feel (move, dash, fire) | `main.js` `updatePlayer()`, `fire()`, `spawnBook()` |
| A menu / screen | `index.html` `<section id=…>` + `main.js` `SCREENS`, the `data-act` click handler, `render*()` for that screen · CSS in `src/game.css` (scope tokens to the component) |
| HUD | `main.js` `drawHUD()` |
| Saved data | `main.js` keys `overdue.*.v1` · progression in `src/meta.js` `normalizeProgress()` (never reshape without a migration) |
| Debug / test hooks | `main.js` `window.__overdue` (bottom) · used by `scripts/qa/run.mjs` and the balance bot |
| Balance bot (story playtests) | `npm run balance` · `scripts/balance.mjs` (runner + report), `balance-bot.mjs` (plays a run in the page), `balance-lib.mjs` (door policy, perks, steering, report maths) |
| QA checks | `scripts/qa/run.mjs` (screens per device, perf, privacy) |

## Files

| File | Lines | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `index.html` | 219 | Page shell: menus and screens as `<section id>` |
| `src/arena.js` | 368 | Procedural, mirrored library layouts on a grid. Pure module (no DOM) so it is unit-testable. |
| `src/audio.js` | 166 | 100% procedural audio: every sound effect and the adaptive soundtrack are synthesised |
| `src/backend.js` | 84 | Score storage. The game is fully static, so there are two places a Hall of Fame can live: |
| `src/catalogue.js` | 140 | Built-in book catalogue: the titles you throw and the authors bosses are named after. |
| `src/doors.js` | 68 | Story doors: after most rooms you pick the next room from 2 doors. Pure module (no DOM) so it is unit-tested. |
| `src/enemy-art.js` | 396 | Enemy art (v1.12.0): every enemy except the boss is drawn here. Look "Blend": library characters (own face per type) |
| `src/flowfield.js` | 102 | Dijkstra flow field: one search from the player gives every enemy a path around the shelves. |
| `src/main.js` | 2543 | OVERDUE! — Night Shift at the Meme Library |
| `src/meta.js` | 99 | Late fees: permanent progression between runs. Pure module (no DOM) so it is unit-tested. |
| `src/palette.js` | 52 | Projectile colours. Pure module (no DOM), unit-tested. |
| `src/story.js` | 154 | Story mode: ten handmade library wings (7 rooms each), unlocked in order. Pure module (no DOM) so it is unit-tested. |
| `src/upgrades.js` | 301 | Perks offered between waves. Pure data + a seeded roller (no DOM), so it is unit-tested. |
| `src/util.js` | 132 | Small, dependency-free helpers shared by the game and its unit tests. |
| `src/version.js` | 22 | Which build of the game is running. The build script injects the real values |
| `src/waves.js` | 59 | Budget-based wave composer. Pure + seeded => every run with the same seed plays the same waves. |
| `test/balance.test.js` | 116 | Balance bot (v1.7.1 tooling): pure helpers only, no browser. See scripts/balance-lib.mjs. |
| `test/doors.test.js` | 138 | Story doors (v1.7.0): pure rules, no DOM. |
| `test/enemy-art.test.js` | 35 | Enemy art colours and the patron ripple (pure data from src/enemy-art.js; no canvas needed). |
| `test/game-logic.test.js` | 612 | Unit tests for the game's pure, DOM-free modules (ES modules loaded via dynamic import). |
| `test/story-meta.test.js` | 270 | Story wings (C) + late-fee Renovations (A): pure rules, no DOM. |
| `scripts/qa/run.mjs` | 749 | OVERDUE! QA suite: `npm run qa` (full) or `npm run qa -- --ci` (relaxed perf thresholds for slow CI runners). |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | 43 | Bundles the game into ONE self-contained HTML file (dist/overdue.html) plus dist/version.json. |
| `scripts/serve.mjs` | 20 | Zero-dependency static server for local play: `npm run dev` then open http://localhost:5173 |
| `scripts/codemap.mjs` | 113 | Generates CODEMAP.md: a token-cheap index of the code, so a session (person or AI) can jump straight |

## test/balance.test.js

- 6: door policies: rare, rest, mixed; Mystery Shelf only as a last resort; fixed doors are taken
- 21: perk priority: specials first, then damage / throw rate / hearts, cursed books last
- 30: steering: runs from a threat, avoids shelves, holds or drifts to centre when nothing is near
- 47: aggregation: clear rate, death rooms, hearts, fines, time, timeouts; errors are left out
- 64: what-stands-out: biggest wing drop, best policy, death pile-up; report renders
- 82: the balance bot knows the wing length
- 88: per-room stats: reached counts, death share and reach-conditional death rate
- 100: survive check: compares with the clear rooms around it, verdict easy / fine / hard
- 110: report shows goal and kind per room

## test/doors.test.js

- 8: door offers are deterministic per (seed, wing, room) and never two of the same type
- 22: The Stacks only replaces Break Room, and only at full health
- 32: doors follow ELITE_ROOM / BOSS_ROOM: fixed elite door, fixed author door, 2-door choice elsewhere, none after the boss
- 52: doors never make a room easier, and Rare Books adds exactly +0.5 elite share (capped at 1)
- 77: door fines: Rare ×2, Break Room halved (rounded up, min 3), the others normal
- 89: Mystery Shelf: deterministic, only unowned unbanned cursed books, otherwise a bonus perk
- 109: Rare Books (v1.7.1): strictly harder in every wing and room; the bite starts at wing 4
- 126: v1.12.2: fixed Elite / Author doors are walked through without a screen; real choices are not

## test/game-logic.test.js

- 7: Rng is deterministic per seed and int() is inclusive
- 19: angleDiff wraps into (-PI, PI]
- 25: pushCircleOutOfRect resolves overlap, including centre-inside case
- 37: arenas are deterministic, symmetric, connected and keep the spawn zone clear
- 54: flow field routes around a wall and never steps into solids
- 75: waves respect budget, unlock order and boss cadence
- 90: rollUpgrades returns distinct, non-maxed perks that mutate stats
- 104: regression: flow field reaches every free cell on generated arenas
- 116: portrait arenas (phones) are connected, symmetric and keep the spawn zone clear
- 130: catalogue has books and authors for every title
- 145: combo cards unlock from their two perks and always take the first slot
- 163: cursed books are one-time, and Lights Out needs lighting on
- 175: rebalance: no single core perk more than doubles output at level 1
- 184: every stackable perk tops out at 3/3 and leads to exactly one Masterwork
- 205: perk cards preview changes in plain player terms
- 221: cards say just the gain, hint at combos, and Banish keeps perks out of the pool
- 237: home-screen app: manifest icons exist and the Pages deploy ships them
- 250: arena shape fits the screen: phones, iPads, laptops, desktops
- 269: version label shows version, commit and date; dev builds say so
- 275: everything the player throws stays out of the red/pink reserved for enemies
- 287: combo partners and combos in reach explain what pairs with what
- 305: perk art: each perk adds one trait, they stack, and normal books stay plain
- 324: aisles are at least 2 cells (60 px) wide in every room, on every screen shape, and never empty
- 352: cornerAssist slides the player around a clipped shelf corner, but not off a head-on face
- 393: cornerAssist + wall collision lets a circle walk past a corner it clips
- 406: every perk has a short name for the build strip, and buildChips links combo partners
- 425: scatter layouts are byte-identical to the pre-shapes generator (endless stays as it was)
- 448: every room shape keeps the rules: connected, clear spawn, no passage under 2 cells, open edges, denser = more shelf
- 482: reading rooms have four openings and bridge walls are continuous but for 2-3 gaps
- 509: aimSource: auto-aim on/off × touch / gamepad / mouse (v1.10.0)
- 524: aimStick: drag vector from where the finger landed, with a deadzone (v1.10.2)
- 538: v1.11.0 special cards say why they are on offer (every Masterwork and combo)
- 551: v1.11.0 level text: now -> after pips, Masterwork teased at 2/3, named at 3/3, never revealed early
- 567: v1.11.0 tips: one at a time, in order, and a seen tip never fires again
- 591: v1.11.2 touching collinear shelves merge into one rect: same cells as solid, nothing left to merge

## test/story-meta.test.js

- 7: every room is harder than the one before it, in every wing
- 17: every wing is harder than the previous wing, room for room
- 32: wing 1 plays like the opening of endless (mapped onto the old curve); room 4 is elite and room 7 a boss
- 55: roomGoal: never room 1, the elite or the boss room; capped per wing; deterministic; most wings have one
- 72: a Survive room is never easier than the same room played plain, and its spawns fill the whole timer
- 95: Survive rooms build up: every spawn lands well before the buzzer and the budget arrives in a rising crescendo
- 118: fines: a full 7-room wing pays within 10% of the old 10-room wing, elite and boss stay the biggest
- 128: an old 10-room save loads safely: best clamps to 7, wing 1 stays cleared, wing 2 stays unlocked
- 135: composeWave without story options is unchanged (endless runs stay reproducible)
- 145: story layouts are fixed per room and every room is connected
- 160: Renovation costs rise with level and every stat stays finite at max
- 175: buying spends fines, refuses when broke or maxed
- 187: runs bank fines, unlock the next wing once, and saves repair themselves
- 213: a lost wing-1 run that dies in the room after the elite room still affords the cheapest Renovation
- 222: every wing has room shapes; elite and boss rooms are open; shapes do not repeat back to back
- 239: even the worst door route (cheapest door every time) still affords the cheapest Renovation by the room after the elite room
- 264: every wing has an intro, taunt and cleared line, each 1-60 characters
